description: Zones allow you to define a specific area of the frame so you can determine whether or not an object is within a particular area.
draw_instructions: Click to draw a polygon on the image.

name.label: Name
name.description: Name must be at least 2 characters and must not be the name of a camera or another zone.

inertia.label: Inertia
inertia.description: Specifies how many frames that an object must be in a zone before they are considered in the zone. Default: 3

loitering_time.label: Loitering Time
loitering_time.description: Sets a minimum amount of time in seconds that the object must be in the zone for it to activate. Default: 0

objects.label: Objects
objects.description: List of objects that apply to this zone.

speed_estimation.label: Speed Estimation
speed_estimation.description: Enable speed estimation for objects in this zone. The zone must have exactly 4 points.

error.points: Zones with speed estimation must have exactly 4 points.
error.loitering: Zones with loitering times greater than 0 should not be used with speed estimation.

threshold.label: Speed Threshold ({{unit}})
threshold.description: Specifies a minimum speed for objects to be considered in this zone.
